shorts_extract.hook: Live two-photon brain microscopy shows spaces between neurons widening 60% the instant deep sleep starts, flushing out amyloid waste at double speed.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Xie & Nedergaard (2013 Science): awake vs sleeping CSF tracer influx, TMA+ 60% interstitial expansion, AQP4 astrocytic water channels, 2x amyloid-beta clearance.
shorts_extract.twist: Waking norepinephrine keeps channels squeezed shut for sharp signaling, and sedative pills that flatten slow vascular waves do not match natural delta sleep.
